subject: Custom domain verification failing
resolution_summary: DNS TXT record was missing for _cloudsync-challenge subdomain. Customer added record and verification passed. Domain verified within TTL window.

subject: iOS app background sync not working
resolution_summary: Background App Refresh was disabled in iOS settings for CloudSync app. Enabled setting and background sync resumed.

subject: Cross-region sync latency increased 400%
resolution_summary: Routed through overloaded eu-central relay. Moved customer to newly deployed eu-west relay. Latency dropped from 850ms to 45ms.
